meta.title: Lecture to knowledge base
meta.description: Turns online lectures (Bilibili, YouTube, DingTalk replays, local files) into an Obsidian course vault: part listing, native subtitles or local transcription, terminology correction, courseware parsing, lecture linting and whitelisted writes. v1 does not read video frames, YouTube needs a proxy first, and Chaoxing only accepts local file import.
